messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kw motor.
The recorded demand forecast for part:350011 changed by +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
Your recorded on-time delivery rate is 90.4 % (sc:70510@2026Q3).
The referenced orders for part:350011 each record a price of EUR 348.32 per price unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20, po:4500014342-10, po:4500014238-20, po:4500014178-30, po:4500014178-20, po:4500014128-10).
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 6,110 pcs per year over 12 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the delivery record data, price history data, and volume change data you cited; they hold, but do not change our calculation, though we took the volume change into account. We acknowledge your commitment to a binding volume of 6,110 pieces over 12 months, which allows us to adjust our pricing, and we welcome your offer of 14-day payment terms, incorporating this into our revised proposal. A binding higher volume helps us and can improve the price; which volume can you commit to? Regarding your request for a cost breakdown, please understand that our calculation is our property and company policy does not permit the disclosure of proprietary cost structures beyond the primary drivers already shared.

We can accept your terms and await your order. Ourangebot stands at a price of €355.93 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: We refer to our standard Zahlungsziel, which is 30 days net.
